name: frontend-dependency-contract
body: Each of the seven apg language frontends (Go, Java, C++, Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Python) plus the bundled structural scanner (Markdown, shell, YAML, JSON, TOML, XML, Dockerfile, Makefile, INI) has its dependency contract stated in the durable spec: (a) its build-time dependencies, (b) its scan-time dependencies (what is present on PATH when a user runs `apg scan`), and (c) the pinned engine whose version sets the language-version ceiling. The declaration is attached to that scanner's solution container, whose body names the code units that carry each dependency, so ""to scan X you need Y and Z"" is answerable and traceable from the spec. The contract is declarative: delivery is the container bodies plus the durable dependency-matrix note, and the change-set's code delta is the documentation update claimed by `solution.component.frontend-dependency-docs` (README.md / AGENTS.md). The per-language frontend containers and the build pipeline carry their dependency declarations and zero `implemented-by` claims — frontend and build code stay untouched, and their absence from the code-coverage surface is deliberate, keeping `modifies` tasks for untouched code out of the verify gate; the bundled structural scanner added in 0.17.0 carries `implemented-by` claims, since it is new code. The container set spans the seven frontends plus the bundle, with the separate Markdown frontend retired into the bundled structural scanner.
